coverage_note: Montana (state 30) LRP Feeder Cattle. steers_w1 = under 600 lb (price adjustment factor 1.10, per-head at 575 lb); steers_w2 = 600-900 lb (factor 1.00, per-head at 600 lb). Producer premium = total premium x (1 - subsidy). Subsidy tiers: >=95% coverage 35%, 90-94.99% 40%, 85-89.99% 45%, 80-84.99% 50%, below 55%.
basis_note: LRP settles on the CME Feeder Cattle Index at the end date, not the ranchers own sale - basis risk remains. Rates reset each sales day off the futures close; not advice.
